summarization: This smartphone UI screen is a sign-up prompt for email notifications. It offers users the option to sign up for emails to receive lesson suggestions, bonus content, surveys, Google news, and other perks. The screen features a prominent "Sign me up" button for users who wish to subscribe, and a "No thanks" option for those who do not. The background text suggests that users can try one lesson each day and get five lesson recommendations each week in Featured Lessons.
